Saint-Pierre Milizac will face Stade Pontivyen in the Coupe de France at Stade Pen Ar Guéar N°1 on 28 November 2026.

Saint-Pierre Milizac has recorded one win from their last two league matches and has drawn each of their previous three home games. Stade Pontivyen enters with three defeats in their past six matches and has drawn once in their last two away fixtures.
